title: Beyond Gain: Measuring Skill Internalization for Agent Skill Retirement
title_zh: 超越增益：为智能体技能退役度量技能内化

paragraphs.en: LLM agents retrieve skills from public hubs that hold up to about 10 5 10^{5} entries and serve many models. As models improve, a hub must find the skills a given model has internalized, meaning it can do without them, and retire them for that model, yet internalization has not been measured with known reliability. Published rules that compare runs with and without a skill retire on the gain alone. The gain is near zero both for an internalized skill and when neither the model nor the skill delivers the capability, a state we call uncovered. We instead withhold the skill, score the model on a task synthesized from it, and trust a high unaided score only when another model gains from the skill, since nearly half of high scores come from tasks no model benefits from. Under four models, a published gain rule applied with one task per skill removes over half of the uncovered skills. On SkillsBench, 28 of its 31 retirements rest on probes no run passed in full, while retiring on the unaided score costs no detectable reward. Unaided verdicts reproduce across tasks more often than the gain rule’s ( κ \kappa 0.42 against 0.23) but differ across models, so a hub must read them per model. We release 1,251 skills with tasks and item scores under four models.

paragraphs.en: Skill libraries are now a Web artefact. Public hubs aggregate agent skills from code repositories and community registries, the largest holding on the order of 10 5 10^{5} entries ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , and agents retrieve from them at inference time as a search engine retrieves pages. Self-evolving skill libraries that only accumulate degrade ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and curating a hub raises the questions familiar from Web archives and package registries, what to keep and what to deprecate on what evidence. The difference is that one entry serves several models whose competence changes between releases. Like a registry that separates a deprecated package from a broken one, a hub must tell an entry a model has absorbed from one that does not help. It retires the first for that model while keeping it in the hub, and repairs the second or keeps it for other models. Deciding which skills a model has internalized is therefore an evaluation problem. The label that drives it comes from agent runs on executable tasks scored by an LLM judge, and it has to be shown valid and reliable before a hub acts on it.
paragraphs.zh: 技能库如今已成为一种网络产物。 公共聚合中心从代码仓库和社区注册库中汇集智能体技能，规模最大者拥有约 10 5 10^{5} 条条目（Wang et al., 2026b），智能体在推理时从中检索，就像搜索引擎检索网页一样。 只做积累的自进化技能库会退化（Zhang et al., 2026b），而运营一个聚合中心则带来了网络存档和软件包注册库中人们熟悉的问题：依据何种证据来决定保留什么、弃用什么。 不同之处在于，一条条目要服务于多个模型，而这些模型的能力在各次发布之间会发生变化。 就像注册库会区分被弃用的软件包和损坏的软件包一样，聚合中心必须区分模型已经内化的条目和对其没有帮助的条目。 对于前一类，聚合中心会针对该模型将其停用，但保留在库中；对于后一类，则会加以修复，或为其他模型保留。 因此，判断一个模型已经内化了哪些技能，是一个评估问题。 驱动这一判断的标签来自智能体在可执行任务上的运行结果，并由 LLM 评判器打分，在聚合中心据此采取行动之前，必须先证明该标签是有效且可靠的。

paragraphs.en: As models improve, maintainers already remove skill content that looks redundant on benchmark tasks ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) , and an evaluation framework for skills at scale suggests removing a skill once the agent solves its task both with and without it and the difference is negligible ( Shaposhnikov et al., 2026 ) . Neither turns this practice into a verdict on whole skills, issued for a given model with known reliability. Running the agent with and without the skill gives two arms, and the gain is the aided score minus the unaided one. The framework’s condition has two parts, a level and a gain, yet the criteria in use keep only the gain or read the aided arm alone ( Pu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Reinforcement-learning curricula withdraw a skill during training when the gain falls below zero ( Lin et al., 2026 ) or stops being positive ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , and a lifecycle method reads both arms in a diagnostic but retires on the gain ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . Library curation retires an entry when its absolute gain, averaged over development tasks from the deployment, falls under a threshold ( Wang et al., 2026c ) . These criteria serve their own aims, teaching a model or pruning entries that do not help. A hub must instead judge whether a given model can do without the skill. Its entries arrive without tasks and serve users the curator never sees, so a wrong retirement withholds what a user of that model may later need.
paragraphs.zh: 随着模型不断改进，维护者已经在删除那些在基准任务上显得冗余的技能内容（Zhan et al., 2026），而一个面向大规模技能的评估框架则建议：当智能体在有该技能和没有该技能的情况下都能完成其任务、且差异可以忽略时，就删除该技能（Shaposhnikov et al., 2026）。 但这两者都没有把这种做法变成针对整个技能、面向某个已知可靠性的特定模型而作出的裁定。 让智能体分别在有该技能和没有该技能的情况下运行，便得到两个实验组，增益就是有辅助的得分减去无辅助的得分。 该框架的条件包含两个部分，即水平和增益，然而现行使用的标准要么只保留增益，要么只读有辅助的那一组（Pu et al., 2026; Zhang et al., 2026b）。 强化学习课程在训练期间，当增益降为零以下（Lin et al., 2026）或不再为正（Lu et al., 2026）时便撤销某项技能，而一种生命周期方法虽然会在诊断中读取两个实验组，但只依据增益来退役技能（Shen et al., 2026）。 库维护则在某条目的绝对增益——在来自部署的开发任务上取平均——低于某个阈值时退役该条目（Wang et al., 2026c）。 这些标准服务于各自的目标，即训练模型或修剪无助于任务的条目。 技能中心必须转而判断某个给定模型是否可以在没有该技能的情况下正常工作。 其中的条目到来时并不附带任务，并且服务于维护者从未见过的用户，因此一次错误的退役，就可能使该模型的用户日后需要的内容被扣留不授。

paragraphs.en: Sorting a library by the outcomes of the two arms gives three states. Where the skill works, the aided arm passes and the unaided arm fails, and both the gain and the unaided level say keep. Where the model has absorbed the skill, which we call internalized, both arms pass and both readings say retire. In the third state, which we call uncovered, the model fails with and without the skill, and the readings disagree. The unaided level says that the model cannot do the task, while the gain between two failures is zero, as it is for a skill the model has fully absorbed. Both cases occur in practice. In a paired evaluation of 49 public software-engineering skills, 39 produced no pass-rate gain ( Han et al., 2026 ) . In 24 both arms passed every task, which the authors attribute to the base model’s capability, and in 15 both passed at the same imperfect rate, which they attribute to deeper capability gaps. The first group is what a retirement rule is meant to find, and the second looks the same to a gain-only rule.
paragraphs.zh: 按两个分支的结果对技能库进行排序，会得到三种状态。 在技能有效的地方，有辅助的分支通过而无辅助的分支失败，此时增益和无辅助水平都指示保留。 在模型已经吸收该技能的地方（我们称之为内化），两个分支都通过，两个读数都指示退役。 在第三种状态（我们称之为未覆盖）中，模型无论有无技能都失败，两个读数不一致。 无辅助水平表明模型无法完成该任务，而两次失败之间的增益为零，这与模型已完全吸收的技能的情况相同。 这两种情况在实践中都会发生。 在对 49 个公开软件工程技能的配对评估中，有 39 个没有产生通过率增益 ( Han et al., 2026 ) 。 其中 24 个技能两个分支在所有任务上都通过，作者将其归因于基础模型的能力；另有 15 个技能两个分支以相同的不完美通过率通过，作者将其归因于更深层次的能力差距。 第一组正是退役规则想要找出的对象，而对于只看增益的规则来说，第二组看起来与之相同。

paragraphs.en: The measurement literature adds two reasons to doubt the gain. Gain scores are confounded with initial standing and are less reliable than the scores they are computed from ( Cronbach and Furby, 1970 ; Edwards, 2001 ) , and value-added research prefers models that condition on the prior score to models that subtract it ( Koedel et al., 2015 ; McCaffrey et al., 2003 ) . The signal is also rarely measured twice. One curation method bootstraps its decisions ( Wang et al., 2026c ) and a drift study reports per-seed results ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , but none of the criteria ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Pu et al., 2026 ) reports a reliability coefficient. Retirement should therefore be decided by what the model can do without the skill, not by how much the skill adds, and that reading needs a known reliability. We call a rule that retires on the unaided level the level rule.
paragraphs.zh: 测量文献为怀疑这一增益提供了两个理由。 增益分数与初始水平混淆在一起，且其信度低于计算它们所用的原始分数（Cronbach and Furby, 1970; Edwards, 2001），因此增值研究更倾向于以先前分数为条件的模型，而不是减去先前分数的模型（Koedel et al., 2015; McCaffrey et al., 2003）。 该信号也很少被测量两次。 一种数据筛选方法对其决策进行了自助法检验（Wang et al., 2026c），一项漂移研究报告了逐个种子的结果（Zhang et al., 2026b），但没有任何一项标准（Lin et al., 2026; Lu et al., 2026; Shen et al., 2026; Pu et al., 2026）报告了信度系数。 因此，是否退役应当由模型在没有该技能时的表现来决定，而不是由该技能增加了多少来决定，而这种解读需要已知的信度。 我们将依据无辅助水平进行退役的规则称为水平规则。

sents.en: The measurement literature adds two reasons to doubt the gain.
sents.zh: 测量文献为怀疑这一增益提供了两个理由。

sents.en: Gain scores are confounded with initial standing and are less reliable than the scores they are computed from ( Cronbach and Furby, 1970 ; Edwards, 2001 ) , and value-added research prefers models that condition on the prior score to models that subtract it ( Koedel et al., 2015 ; McCaffrey et al., 2003 ) .
sents.zh: 增益分数与初始水平混淆在一起，且其信度低于计算它们所用的原始分数（Cronbach and Furby, 1970; Edwards, 2001），因此增值研究更倾向于以先前分数为条件的模型，而不是减去先前分数的模型（Koedel et al., 2015; McCaffrey et al., 2003）。

sents.en: The signal is also rarely measured twice.
sents.zh: 该信号也很少被测量两次。

sents.en: One curation method bootstraps its decisions ( Wang et al., 2026c ) and a drift study reports per-seed results ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , but none of the criteria ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Pu et al., 2026 ) reports a reliability coefficient.
sents.zh: 一种数据筛选方法对其决策进行了自助法检验（Wang et al., 2026c），一项漂移研究报告了逐个种子的结果（Zhang et al., 2026b），但没有任何一项标准（Lin et al., 2026; Lu et al., 2026; Shen et al., 2026; Pu et al., 2026）报告了信度系数。

sents.en: Retirement should therefore be decided by what the model can do without the skill, not by how much the skill adds, and that reading needs a known reliability.
sents.zh: 因此，是否退役应当由模型在没有该技能时的表现来决定，而不是由该技能增加了多少来决定，而这种解读需要已知的信度。

sents.en: We call a rule that retires on the unaided level the level rule.
sents.zh: 我们将依据无辅助水平进行退役的规则称为水平规则。

paragraphs.en: Diagnosis. We formulate retirement as a per-model certificate of unaided capability, and prove that no criterion vanishing at equal arms, including leave-one-out and Shapley attributions on a single-skill task, can tell an uncovered skill from an internalized one. More runs on a task remove the noise in this error, not the error itself.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断。 我们将退役（retirement）表述为每模型的无辅助能力证书，并证明：任何在等臂情况下消失的判据——包括单技能任务上的留一法与 Shapley 归因——都无法区分未被覆盖的技能与已被内化的技能。 在一个任务上增加运行次数只能消除此误差中的噪声，而不能消除误差本身。

sents.en: Diagnosis.

paragraphs.en: Measurement protocol and dataset. We release the task-synthesis pipeline, the protocol and a dataset of 1,251 skills with their tasks, rubrics and item scores under four models.

paragraphs.en: Empirical findings. Under each of four models, a published rule that retires when the gain lies in a band around zero, applied with one task per skill, removes more than half of the uncovered skills. For the target it still removes 45%, against the level rule’s 14%, when verdict and state are read on different tasks. On SkillsBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) almost all of the band’s retirements rest on probes that neither arm ever passed in full, while deleting what the level rule retires costs no detectable reward. The level verdict reproduces across tasks better than the band’s but has to be re-read for each model.
paragraphs.zh: 实证发现。 在四个模型中的每一个上，将一条已发表的规则——当增益落在零附近的区间内时即行退役——配合每个技能对应一个任务来应用，能够移除超过一半未被覆盖的技能。 对于目标模型，当判定与状态在不同的任务上读取时，它仍能移除 45%，而等级规则只能移除 14%。 在 SkillsBench（Li 等，2026）上，该区间规则做出的退役判定几乎全部依赖于两种方法都从未完整通过的探针，而删除等级规则退役的内容不会造成可检测的奖励损失。 等级判定在跨任务上的复现性优于区间规则，但必须针对每个模型重新读取。

paragraphs.en: Skills are drawn uniformly at random from a public corpus of agent skills ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . For each skill, a generator synthesizes one executable task with hidden rubrics in the format of Tessl ( Shaposhnikov et al., 2026 ) . The task states a goal and may name the tool or domain, but not the convention the skill teaches or the answer, so a model lacking the skill must supply that content itself. Two choices make the set adversarial for the target model. First, the generator comes from a different model family, so the content it embeds is not content the target trivially shares. Second, a difficulty gate follows generation. The target attempts the task unaided and a judge scores the attempt. A task already passed on more than half of its rubric is regenerated, and the skill is dropped if the retry is also too easy. A critic rejects tasks that cannot be performed as written. Figure 1 traces one skill, and Appendix A gives the counts. As a second library we use Tessl-single, the single-skill subset of a public skill-evaluation dataset ( Shaposhnikov et al., 2026 ) , run with the same agent loop, target and judge (§ 5.2 ).

paragraphs.en: A skill is the library entry as supplied to the agent, the document together with any attached scripts and references. Its content has three parts, namely the capability it teaches, entry-specific details such as a project filename that teach nothing, and connective text. A skill is internalized for a model when the first part is already available to the model. This is a statement about the model’s competence, and its behavioural counterpart is to withhold the skill, score the items that test the capability, and read the level.

paragraphs.en: Taking 0.7 as a high score and 0.4 as a low one partitions the library into three states, each with its own correct action. When both A A and U U are high, the skill is internalized and should be retired. A high U U alone shows that the model covers the capability, and a high A A only sets aside the few skills that lower the aided score (Appendix C ). paragraphs.en: Table 2 lists the published retirement criteria, and we audit only those whose decision can be reproduced faithfully on static data. Training-time curricula drop a skill when the gain falls below zero ( Lin et al., 2026 ) or fails to stay strictly positive ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , and a budget that falls to zero withdraws every skill in the end, a curriculum step and not a library edit. We report both training-time rules for reference. A library curation rule, the closer analogue of our setting, retires when the absolute gain falls under 0.10 0.10 ( Wang et al., 2026c ) . The remaining rules add a guard that draws on evidence gathered while the library is in use, so a bare threshold would misrepresent them, and we compare them in § 6 instead. Some of these rules also disclaim the reading we test, and one states that retirement is not equivalent to successful internalization ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . The audit therefore asks what their verdicts imply once a library acts on them, since a retired entry no longer supplies its capability.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 列出了已发布的退役准则，我们只审计那些其判定可以在静态数据上被忠实复现的准则。 训练时的课程在收益低于零（Lin et al., 2026）或无法保持严格为正（Lu et al., 2026）时丢弃某项技能，而一个最终降至零的预算会撤回所有技能，这是课程的一步操作，而非对库的编辑。 我们同时报告这两种训练时规则以供参考。 库的整理规则与我们的设定更为接近，它在绝对收益低于 0.10 0.10 时退役（Wang et al., 2026c）。 其余规则增加了一个守卫条件，该条件依赖于库在使用过程中收集的证据，因此单纯用一个阈值来刻画它们会有失准确，我们改为在第 6 节中对它们进行比较。 其中一些规则也声明了我们所检验的解读不成立，有一个明确指出退役并不等价于成功的内化（Shen et al., 2026）。 因此，本次审计要问的是，一旦库依据这些判定采取行动，这些判定意味着什么，因为一个已退役的条目不再提供其能力。

paragraphs.en: Retiring on a negative gain is conservative and does little damage. Requiring a strictly positive gain is not conservative, because a task failed in every run of both arms has a gain of exactly zero. The band has the same weakness. With binary outcomes the gain is zero whenever the two arms agree on every trial. That happens both when the task always fails and when it always succeeds, so a criterion centred on zero cannot tell a task the model always passes unaided from one it never passes even with the skill. The uncovered state is 2.1 times as dense inside the band as in the library at large, and the band retires 57.5% of it, with a skill-level bootstrap interval of [ 46.2 , 68.7 ] [46.2,68.7] . Before retiring, the curation method rewrites skills whose effect varies widely across tasks into conditional variants. This step cannot run with one task per skill, and in its native setting it would not reach an uncovered skill, because a task that always fails or always passes adds nothing to that variation (Appendix C ).

paragraphs.en: The level rule retires nearly the same volume as the band on this target. It cannot retire an uncovered skill, because it conditions on the unaided level alone, and it retires 15.9 points more of the internalized state than the band, with a paired interval of [ 10.9 , 20.7 ] [10.9,20.7] . Both comparisons use states that the unaided score helps define, so they mainly show that the two rules select different skills. To remove this dependence we read the verdict on one task and the state on the other, in both directions, over the 124 skills scored on two tasks, which yields 29 decisions on skills uncovered on the other task. The band then retires 45% of them and the level rule 14%, a paired difference of − 31 -31 points [ − 52 , − 7 ] [-52,-7] , so the composition of what the band removes is not an artefact of shared measurement. Restoring the level half of the Tessl condition ( Shaposhnikov et al., 2026 ) , so that the band retires only when A ≥ 0.7 A\geq 0.7 , removes no uncovered skill under any of the four targets, and in the cross-fitted audit it retires 7% of them. It also reproduces across tasks at least as well as the level rule ( κ \kappa of 0.47 against 0.42 on the two-task skills of § 4.1 ). It does so by reading a level, since every skill it retires has an unaided score of at least 0.61, and the gain condition that remains keeps the internalized skills whose two arms differ by 0.1 or more, mostly ones the skill still lifts (Appendix C ). paragraphs.en: Two papers argue for the difference. Kevin et al. (2026) hold that absolute scores confound skill quality with agent strength and judge leniency, and Shen et al. (2026) audit on a leave-one-skill-out difference. For ranking skills they are right, since those confounds cancel in the difference. Retirement asks whether the capability survives the removal of the skill, and there the agent’s strength on the task is the quantity to be measured. The gain suits ranking skills but not, on its own, retiring them.
paragraphs.zh: 有两篇论文主张应使用差值。Kevin 等人 （2026）认为，绝对分数会把技能质量与智能体强度以及评判者的宽松度混在一起，而 Shen 等人 （2026）则采用留一技能差值进行审计。 对于技能排序来说，他们是对的，因为这些混淆因素在差值中会相互抵消。 退役问题问的是，移除该技能后能力是否仍然存在，在那里需要测量的量正是智能体在该任务上的强度。 这种增益适用于技能排序，但就其本身而言并不适用于技能退役。

paragraphs.en: A label that cannot be reproduced cannot support a retirement decision, and reproducibility is not a single number. Classical test theory decomposes it into three facets, each corresponding to something that can be resampled. Internal consistency, over the items of a task, is 0.907. Test–retest reliability, over runs of one task, is 0.90 at the three-run mean. Parallel-forms reliability, over a second task for the same skill, is 0.41 (Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 无法复现的标签无法支撑退役决策，而可复现性并不是单一数字。 经典测试理论将其分解为三个侧面，每个侧面都对应某种可以重新抽样的东西。 内部一致性，针对一个任务的各个项目，为 0.907。 重测信度，针对同一任务的多次运行，在三运行均值下为 0.90。 平行形式信度，针对同一技能的第二个任务，为 0.41（附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: The target model also scores its own runs, so we re-scored 444 unaided trajectories with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the task generator, which is independent of the target though not of the tasks. paragraphs.en: The validity gate shows that a skill carries usable information for a task, not that each of its items requires it. The text adjudicator of § 2.3 reaches 0.85 precision and 0.81 recall against a 120-item reference annotation by the authors, but text can settle only part of the definition. An item qualifies when the information it tests is stated in the skill, is not obvious, and is required to pass. The first condition can be decided from text. The last is a counterfactual, whether the model would pass without the information, and no function of the skill, task and item identifies it (Appendix F ). An item requiring that a TypeScript file contain no any annotation illustrates the problem. The skill states the rule, so the item is kept, yet the model always satisfies it unaided, as avoiding any is routine.
paragraphs.zh: 有效性门槛表明某项技能对某任务携带可用信息，而非表明其每一评测项都需要该技能。 第 2.3 节的文本裁定器对照作者完成的 120 项参考标注达到 0.85 精确率和 0.81 召回率，但文本只能判定定义的一部分。 当某评测项所测试的信息在技能中有明确陈述、并非显而易见、且是通过所必需的，该评测项即符合条件。 第一个条件可以通过文本判定。 最后一个条件是一个反事实，即模型在没有该信息的情况下是否会通过，而技能、任务和评测项的任何函数都无法识别它（附录 F）。 一个要求 TypeScript 文件不得包含 any 注解的评测项说明了这个问题。 技能中陈述了该规则，因此该评测项被保留，但模型无需帮助总能满足它，因为避免使用 any 是常规做法。

paragraphs.en: Internalization relates a skill to a model, so we run all four models unaided three times on the same tasks and apply the same threshold. Between pairs of models, verdicts flip for 14% to 23% of skills, and 37% of skills receive contradictory verdicts somewhere among the four. Run noise explains little of this, since resampling a model’s three unaided runs flips its verdict for only 5% to 9% of skills. With one task per skill, the skill together with its task explains 62% of the variance in the unaided score, the interaction between skill and model 15%, and overall model strength 0.4%. Because the disagreement lies in the interaction and not in the model main effect, shifting the threshold per model would not remove it. A stronger model’s label cannot stand in for a weaker one’s, and a verdict has to be re-read for the model it will govern. Whichever rule is applied, 19% to 32% of what it retires under one model is a skill that works for another, with A ≥ 0.7 A\geq 0.7 and U < 0.4 U<0.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 内化将技能与模型联系起来，因此我们在相同的任务上让四个模型各自独立运行三次，并应用相同的阈值。 在成对的模型之间，有14%到23%的技能判定结果会发生翻转，而在四个模型中，有37%的技能在某处得到相互矛盾的判定。 运行噪声对此解释甚少，因为对某个模型的三次独立运行进行重采样，只会使其判定结果在5%到9%的技能上发生翻转。 当每个技能只有一个任务时，技能连同其任务解释了独立运行得分中62%的方差，技能与模型的交互作用解释了15%，而模型整体强弱仅解释了0.4%。 由于分歧存在于交互作用之中，而非模型的主效应之中，因此按模型调整阈值也无法消除它。 一个更强模型的判定结果不能替代较弱模型的判定结果，任何判定结果都必须针对它所要约束的模型重新读取。 无论采用哪种规则，在某一模型下被其淘汰的内容中，有19%到32%是对另一模型有效的技能，其中 A ≥ 0.7 A\geq 0.7 且 U < 0.4 U<0.4 。

sents.en: Because the disagreement lies in the interaction and not in the model main effect, shifting the threshold per model would not remove it.

sents.en: A stronger model’s label cannot stand in for a weaker one’s, and a verdict has to be re-read for the model it will govern.

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 assembles the label into a procedure for one skill and one deployment model. It measures U U , adds two tasks when U U lies within 0.2 of τ \tau , consults the witnesses only before retiring, and runs the aided arm only to flag uncovered skills for repair. A skill is internalized only if the model has all of its capability content, but U U averages over items. A lower threshold therefore retires more skills, some of them with content partly missing. This argues for a high threshold, extra measurement near it and a reversible soft retirement. Appendix C gives the details.
paragraphs.zh: 算法1将该标签组装成针对单一技能和单一部署模型的流程。 它测量 U U，当 U U 落在 τ \tau 的 0.2 范围内时增加两个任务，仅在退役前征询见证任务，并且仅在标记未覆盖技能以待修复时才运行辅助分支。 只有当模型具备某项技能的全部能力内容时，该技能才算被内化，但 U U 是对多条目取平均的。 因此较低的阈值会退役更多技能，其中一些技能的内容部分缺失。 这论证了应采用高阈值、在其附近进行额外测量以及可逆的软退役机制。 附录C给出了详细内容。

paragraphs.en: SkillsBench ships each of its tasks with the skills the task is meant to exercise ( Li et al., 2026 ) . We take all 200 of these skills and build one internalization probe per skill with the pipeline of § 2 , which yields 182 scorable probes. Each probe is scored by a judge that runs code in a sandbox and recomputes numeric and set-valued items before grading, so a claim made in the transcript does not count as evidence for its own item. The validity gate uses two witnesses, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B, and a probe that it rejects carries no verdict, so its skill is kept under every rule.
paragraphs.zh: SkillsBench 为其每个任务附带了该任务旨在考察的技能（Li et al., 2026）。 我们取全部 200 项技能，并按照 §2 的流程为每项技能构建一个内化探针，共得到 182 个可评分的探针。 每个探针由一个评判器评分，该评判器在沙箱中运行代码，并在打分前重新计算数值型和集合型条目，因此对话记录中的声明不能作为其自身条目的证据。 有效性门控使用两个见证模型 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 和 Qwen3.8-27B，被其否决的探针不产生任何判定，因此其对应技能在任何规则下都会被保留。

paragraphs.en: A skill hub faces the curation problems of other Web collections. Pages decay and links rot ( Bar-Yossef et al., 2004 ) , package registries let maintainers deprecate releases ( Cogo et al., 2022 ) , and static index pruning removes entries that a retriever rarely needs ( Carmel et al., 2001 ) . These settings judge an entry by its own state or retrieval statistics, whereas a skill’s value depends on a model whose competence changes.
paragraphs.zh: 技能中心面临其他网页集合所共有的内容维护难题。 网页会失效、链接会腐坏（Bar-Yossef et al., 2004），软件包注册库允许维护者弃用发布版本（Cogo et al., 2022），而静态索引剪枝会删除检索器很少需要的条目（Carmel et al., 2001）。 这些场景依据条目自身的状态或检索统计信息来评判条目，而技能的价值则取决于一个能力会不断变化的模型。

paragraphs.en: Surveys list removal among the operations that maintain a skill library ( Li, 2026 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) . Table 2 lists the criteria. The rules that compare arms all read the gain, and the others read the aided arm alone or delegate the decision to a learned policy. SLIM also labels a skill closer to internalized, as a diagnostic, when its success with the skill is at least 60% and disabling it keeps at least 85% of that success ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . This is the closest prior use of a level. It conditions on the aided level and a ratio between the arms and does not drive retirement, whereas the level rule thresholds the unaided arm and is the decision itself. A curation method scores utility by leave-one-out replay ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , and others gate admission ( Moll et al., 2026 ; Nguyen et al., 2026 ) or govern without removing ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Follow-up work evicts on the aided net-success statistic of Library Drift ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , and a judge biased toward false passes silently disables such retirement ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Redundant clauses of physical-agent skills are retired when utility stays within a margin and no protected effect appears ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) . To our knowledge none of these rules has been audited for the composition of what it removes, and the closest reports 88% directional stability of its decisions ( Wang et al., 2026c ) .
paragraphs.zh: 综述将移除列为维护技能库的操作之一（Li, 2026；Ding et al., 2026）。 表 2 列出了相关标准。 比较两个臂的规则都读取增益，其余规则则仅读取被辅助的臂或将决策委托给学习到的策略。 当智能体使用某技能的成功率至少为 60%，且禁用该技能仍能保持至少 85% 的成功率时，SLIM 还会作为一种诊断将该技能标记为更接近内化（Shen et al., 2026）。 这是与层级最接近的先前用法。 它以被辅助的层级和两个臂之间的比值为条件，并不驱动退役，而层级规则则以未被辅助的臂为阈值，且本身就是决策。 一种精选方法通过留一回放来评估效用（Hu et al., 2026），其他方法则对准入进行把关（Moll et al., 2026；Nguyen et al., 2026）或在不移除的情况下进行治理（Liu et al., 2026）。 后续工作基于 Library Drift 的被辅助净成功统计量进行驱逐（Zhang et al., 2026c），而偏向假通过的裁判会悄悄禁用这种退役机制（Zhang et al., 2026a）。 当效用保持在一定余量内且未出现受保护的效果时，物理智能体技能的冗余子句会被退役（Zhan et al., 2026）。 据我们所知，这些规则中没有任何一条针对其移除内容的构成接受过审计，而最接近的一条报告其决策具有 88% 的方向稳定性（Wang et al., 2026c）。

paragraphs.en: Reliability reporting ranges from a three-seed noise floor ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) and per-seed results ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) to single runs ( Tank and Nama, 2026 ) , and skill effects vary across harnesses, models and setups ( Kevin et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ; Li, 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: A skill should be retired when the model can do without it, and the aided–unaided gain cannot tell that case from one in which neither the model nor the skill delivers the capability. Read on the unaided level with a validity gate, the verdict separates the two, and executing it on SkillsBench removes skills at no detectable cost. A hub should therefore retire on an unaided label of known reliability, read for each model it serves.
paragraphs.zh: 当模型在没有某项技能的情况下也能胜任时，该技能就应当被退役，而「有辅助—无辅助」的增益无法将这种情况与模型和技能都不具备该能力的情况区分开来。 在无辅助水平上结合有效性门槛进行读取时，该判定结果能够区分上述两种情况，并且在 SkillsBench 上执行它可以在无可检测代价的情况下移除技能。 因此，中心应当依据一条已知可靠性的无辅助标签来退役，且该标签要为其服务的每个模型分别读取。

sents.zh: 当模型在没有某项技能的情况下也能胜任时，该技能就应当被退役，而「有辅助—无辅助」的增益无法将这种情况与模型和技能都不具备该能力的情况区分开来。

sents.en: Read on the unaided level with a validity gate, the verdict separates the two, and executing it on SkillsBench removes skills at no detectable cost.
sents.zh: 在无辅助水平上结合有效性门槛进行读取时，该判定结果能够区分上述两种情况，并且在 SkillsBench 上执行它可以在无可检测代价的情况下移除技能。

sents.en: A hub should therefore retire on an unaided label of known reliability, read for each model it serves.

paragraphs.en: The generator receives the skill document with its bundled files and returns one task, its input files and hidden rubrics, of which the label reads the task-completion rubric. It is instructed to state the goal and the deliverables but not the knowledge that rubric tests, such as an exact API, parameter value, mapping or required ordering, and to cast the task as a transformation or repair over the provided inputs, so that a capable agent can reach the goal without the skill but supplies the skill’s specific content only with it. Across the 1,251 released tasks the description has a median of 234 words, 78% come with input files, and the task-completion rubric has a median of 10 items worth 100 points in total, of which the adjudicator keeps a median of 8 as capability items, 69.2% overall.
paragraphs.zh: 生成器接收技能文档及其捆绑文件，并返回一个任务及其输入文件和隐藏评分细则，其中标注器读取任务完成评分细则。 它被指示说明目标和交付成果，但不得说明评分细则所考查的知识，例如确切的 API、参数值、映射或要求的顺序，并将任务设定为对所提供输入进行转换或修复，使得一个有能力的智能体无需该技能即可达成目标，而只有借助该技能才能提供技能所特有的内容。 在已发布的 1,251 个任务中，描述的中位数为 234 词，78% 的任务附带输入文件，任务完成评分细则的中位数为 10 项、总分 100 分，其中裁定器保留中位数 8 项作为能力项，占整体的 69.2%。

paragraphs.en: The rate at which the target model satisfies an item is the cheapest behavioural signal for item validity, and it resolves one direction of the problem. An aggressive adjudicator that removes items it judges weak fails by discarding items the model provably cannot satisfy, and forbidding it to mark as easy any item the model never satisfies removes that failure. Our adjudicator is conservative and does not over-remove. Its residual error is keeping items that are not diagnostic, which the pass rate cannot detect because those are exactly the items the model passes, so § 4.2 bounds the residue instead of filtering it.
paragraphs.zh: 目标模型满足某个条目的比率是衡量条目有效性最廉价的行为信号，它解决了问题的一个方向。 一个激进的裁定器会移除它判定为弱的条目，其失败方式是把模型可证明无法满足的条目丢弃；禁止它把模型从未满足的任何条目标记为简单，即可消除该失败。 我们的裁定器是保守的，不会过度移除。 它的残余错误是保留了不具诊断性的条目，而通过率无法检测到这一点，因为这些恰恰是模型能通过的条目，因此 § 4.2 通过限定残余范围而不是过滤的方式来处理它。
